source: Coinbase Exchange public candles API (granularity 60 s), close prices
method: Per-symbol log returns rescaled to HACK volatility (~1.22% per step), compounded from 100, rounded to integer ticks. 1 real minute = 1 simulated second. Single steps capped at 6x that volatility. Windows with >2% missing minutes are skipped; single missing minutes are flat.
